chunks: And whatever is in it from ʿIsa ibn Aʿyan, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn ʿAli ibn al-Ṣalt, from Abu Ṭalib ʿAbdullah ibn al-Ṣalt, from ʿAbdullah ibn al-Mughirah, from ʿIsa ibn Aʿyan.

key_terms.رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: may Allah be pleased with him; an honorific supplication for the narrator's father
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I have narrated it; indicating direct transmission by the compiler
key_terms.عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ: from ʿAbdullah ibn al-Mughirah; a transmitter in the chain
key_terms.عَنْ عِيسَى بْنِ أَعْيَنَ: from ʿIsa ibn Aʿyan; the endpoint of this cited chain

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to ʿIsa ibn Aʿyan in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from ʿIsa ibn Aʿyan. Its significance lies in documenting the precise chain of transmission in hadith literature, which is essential for identifying sources and preserving scholarly reliability.
